name: completion-sdk-imports
goal: Keep public planning and profiling imports usable in empty Bun and Node consumers without framework compilers; defer coding audit dependencies until requested.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Packed planning and profiling imports must work without Svelte in empty Bun and Node consumers; coding audits load their tools only when requested.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard packed-consumer guard caught the eager compiler import. Earlier focused checks used installed workspace compilers. Extend its existing verification case to cold Node execution alongside Bun.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Accepted red e448ea9d at 295b517b3: packed consumers cannot import svelte/compiler; tests and runner inputs were committed before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Defer the code auditor and ship its compiler dependencies in private API chunks; keep planning imports framework-free.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted green 7161e604 at 5ff7f6478: the same frozen SDK tests pass with the same controlled environment, including cold Bun and Node consumers.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: The frozen packed API and verification matrix passes. API declarations, formatting and relevant lint pass. This SDK repair changes no UI; repository-wide checks remain tracked separately.
